scientific_integrity: An elementary complete characteristic-split count with exact finite-field verification in six orders, including two independent exhaustive literal-pair tests. Publication priority is provisional and mathematical validation is not independent.
scientific_limitations: Applies to all finite fields, but only to the six-dimensional upper-triangular 3-by-3 algebra, the zero Jordan-product target, and ordered pairs. No claim for higher size, other products, or orbit counts.
title: Anticommuting probabilities for triangular 3-by-3 matrix algebras over finite fields
